newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-HAGI SENT OFF IN GALATASARAY DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-HAGI SENT OFF IN GALATASARAY DEFEAT.

text.p: Romanian World Cup playmaker Gheorghe Hagi was sent off as Galatasaray were beaten 3-2 by city rivals Fenerbahce and surrendered their outright lead in the Turkish league on Sunday.
Hagi was dismissed in the 78th minute for his second bookable offence when he pushed a Fenerbahce player when the ball was at the other end of the pitch.
Victory put Fenerbahce level on points with Galatasaray at the top of the table and gave new coach Todor Veselinovic something to celebrate in his first match in charge.
Fenerbahce's Bosnian striker Elvir Bolic scored twice after 1-1/2 months without a goal in a scrappy match played in dense fog in Fenerbahce's Kadikoy stadium on the Asian side of Istanbul.
Fenerbahce sacked Brazilian coach Sebastiao Lazaroni just before the derby with Galatasaray and called in Veselinovic to try to restore their fortunes.
The club had scored just two goals in the second half of the season and been knocked out of the domestic cup.
Galatasaray had fared even worse, scoring just one goal in 1997 and failing to win a match. Their fortunes did not improve on Sunday.
Nigerian Augustine "Jay Jay" Okocha gave the home side the lead in the 15th minute after a header from Bolic rebounded off the shoulder of Galatasaray goalkeeper Mehmet Sen.
Defender Vedat Inceefe equalised for Galatasaray in the 19th minute.

Bolic scored his first goal from the penalty spot to make it 2-1 in the 52nd minute and netted his second in the 78th thanks to a blunder by goalkeeper Sen, who cradled a weak cross from the Bosnian in his arms but then let it dribble into the back of the goal.
Substitute Arif Erdem reduced the deficit with a goal from a free kick in the 90th minute but it was too late to save Galatasaray, who were beaten 4-0 by Fenerbahce earlier in the season.
Galatasaray striker Hakan Sukur, who has not scored since netting a hat-trick against Bursaspor before the mid-season break, missed at least five scoring chances in the first half.

Fenerbahce - Fevzi Layic, Ilker Yagcioglu, Uche Okechukwu, Jes Hogh, Erol Bulut (Halil Ibrahim Kara), Selahattin Ozbir (Mustafa Dogan, 82), Saffet Akbak, Augustine "Jay Jay" Okocha, Tayfun Korkut, Elvir Bolic, Saffet Sancakli (Tuncay Akgun 70).
Galatasaray - Mehmet Sen, Bulent Korkmaz, Vedat Inceefe, Bekir Gul, Iulian Filipescu, Suat Kaya (Arif Erdem, 62), Tugay Kerimoglu, Gheorghe Hagi, Ergun Pembe, Hakan Sukur.
